product.title: Norix Attenda Anti-Ligature Floor-Mount Desk – ATN601
product.body_html:
The Norix Attenda Anti-Ligature Floor-Mount Desk is a molded desk for resident rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. The base is rotationally molded from high-impact polyethylene, filled with rigid polyurethane foam for strength and sound absorption, and shaped with a built-in modesty panel. The high-pressure laminate top is fastened to the base with a steel-to-steel connection, and its molded edge is rounded for safety.

The base has no internal openings, and its slightly textured surface resists blood, urine, feces, vinegar, salt solution, and chlorine solution, so it can be cleaned with bleach solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants. Pair it with a Norix Vesta chair or an Attenda Floor-Mount Stool to complete the desk area.

  • Construction: Rotationally molded high-impact polyethylene base with UV stabilizers, filled with rigid polyurethane foam
  • Desk Top: High-pressure laminate over 45 lb density M3 particle board, with a radiused molded edge
  • Top Attachment: Embedded T-nuts for a secure steel-to-steel connection to the base
  • Overall Dimensions: 35.6” W × 23.7” D × 30.1” H
  • Weight: 48 lbs
  • Base Colors: Twilight, Cove, Sand, Sienna, Dove
  • Top Laminates: Kensington Maple, Wild Cherry, Asian Sun, Montana Walnut, Palisades Oak
  • Static Load Testing: Tested to 1,000 lbs
  • Flammability Standards: California Technical Bulletin 133 and 117, UL 1056, ASTM E1537, and NFPA 261
  • Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
  • Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty
  • Intended Use: Indoor use only
  • Country of Manufacture: USA

Installation and Options

  • Floor-Mounted Installation: Designed to be mounted to the floor; mounting hardware is not included
  • Assembly: None required

Applications

The Norix Attenda Floor-Mount Desk gives residents a sturdy work surface in rooms where ligature resistance, durability, and easy cleaning are important considerations.

Typical applications include:

  • Behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
  • Correctional and detention facilities
  • Other supervised residential and institutional settings

Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.

About Norix Attenda Molded Bedroom Series

The Norix Attenda Series is a line of molded bedroom furniture for behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. It includes beds, nightstands, open chests, desks, a stool, wall-mounted storage units, and a wardrobe, all molded from high-impact polyethylene in a clean, contemporary style. Each piece is designed to attach flush to the wall or floor.

Common characteristics of the Attenda Series include:

  • Molded Construction: Rotationally molded high-impact polyethylene with smooth, rounded edges
  • Ligature-Resistant Design: Molded shapes without pass-throughs or tie-off points to help reduce ligature risk
  • Contraband-Resistant Design: No creases or nooks, which helps reduce places to hide contraband
  • Easy Cleaning: Chemically resistant surfaces that can be cleaned with bleach solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants
  • TruColor™ Technology: Fully compounded color for a consistent finish without streaks or speckles

About Norix Furniture

Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.
